description: Quarterly Liberation Metric aggregate report (no PII). Mission KPI for ADR-2605261000 §4. Published by ChartersComplianceRegistry.reportLiberationMetric(). Aggregation enforced structurally (cf. ADR-2605260215 yakushi cross-actor AE aggregation pattern). All quantities are integer-with-implied-units per ADR-2605190900 (no float types in Lexicons).

aggregateLaborHoursReduction.description: All labor-hours figures are centihours per week (1 hr/wk = 100). e.g. 38.2 hr/wk = 3820.

totalReductionMedianCentihrsWk.description: Median total labor-hours reduction vs join baseline, centihours/week (×100)

achievementRatioPermille.description: totalReduction / targetReduction, per-mille (×1000); stage advances only at ≥800 (=0.8) × 2 consecutive quarters

wellbecomingFailureRateBps.description: Fraction of adherents currently on stage-hold for Wellbecoming attestation failure, basis points (×10000; 0.012 = 120)

exitRateBps.description: Voluntary stage-exit rate for the quarter, basis points (×10000)

basicHighIncome.description: Non-cash income/asset accounting per ADR-2605301020 (Basic High Income doctrine — clarifying extension of this ADR's §5 N1). Aggregate-only; no per-adherent figures (no leaderboard → no class formation, §7 + N6). Computed by toritate (ADR-2605262900) imputed_income_compute + commons_asset_value cells over encrypted per-adherent figures (ADR-2605181100). cashStipendUsdMicros is a structural invariant fixed at 0 = on-chain proof that N1 (no fiat-replacement UBI) holds. All USD quantities are micros (1 USD = 1000000) per ADR-2605190900.

imputedIncomeMedianUsdMicrosYr.description: FLOW. Market-equivalent value of in-kind services consumed per adherent at this stage (trailing 12-month median), USD micros/year (×1e6). NOT cash paid — provisioning is in-kind. Valued via the versioned table named in imputedIncomeValuationMethod.

imputedIncomeValuationMethod.description: Versioned valuation-method id resolving to an open, Council-attested table under orgs/etzhayyim/com-etzhayyim-toritate/valuation/ (e.g. v1-retail-equiv). Method-versioning makes the imputed figure auditable.

commonsAssetAccessMedianUsdMicros.description: STOCK. Market-equivalent value of the SBT-bound NON-ALIENABLE commons-asset ACCESS per adherent (Land Trust residency / actor-mesh productive output / kotoba data substrate / hikari energy infra), USD micros (×1e6). An access right, never title — never sellable, transferable, collateralizable, or inheritable as title (ADR-2605301020 §2; generalizes ADR-2605192245 land waqf inalienability).

highIncomeBenchmarkRatioPermille.description: (imputedIncome + commonsAssetAccess) measured against the OECD upper-income-decile household consumption basket, per-mille (×1000). Target ≥1000 (=1.0) at L6 (a target, not a promise — N8 asymptotic); rises across the ladder.

cashStipendUsdMicros.description: INVARIANT ≡ 0. Its presence-and-zero in EVERY report is the structural on-chain proof that §5 N1 holds (no cash stipend replaces a wage; the wage's NEED is removed by in-kind provisioning). Any nonzero value is a constitutional violation.

publicFundReserveUsdcMicros.description: Current Public Fund USDC reserve vs §3 sizing target, USDC micros (×1e6)
